fullPassage:
The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.

(B) The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system.

(A) However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world.

(C) Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of (A)[mechanisms / obstacles] have been developed to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that (B)[adequate / excessive] amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the (C)[domestic / foreign] farming system.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① mechanisms — adequate — domestic: 원문 일치
❌ ② foreign: 국내 농업 시스템이므로 domestic이 맞음
❌ ③ obstacles: 목표 실현을 위해 '장애물'이 아닌 '방법'이 개발됨
❌ ④ excessive: 과도한 양이 아닌 충분한 양
det.tip: mechanism(방법, 체계) ↔ obstacle(장애물), adequate(충분한) ↔ excessive(과도한), domestic(국내의) ↔ foreign(해외의)

questions.passage: However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can (A)[import / export] food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly (B)[sensitive / resistant] to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely (C)[productive / unproductive] agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ import — sensitive — productive: 원문 일치
❌ ① resistant: 농산물은 기후에 '저항력이 있는' 것이 아니라 '민감한' 것
❌ ② export: 국내에서 쉽게 생산되지 않는 것을 '수출'이 아닌 '수입'
❌ ④ unproductive: 극도로 '비생산적인'이 아닌 '생산적인' 농업 부문
det.tip: import(수입) ↔ export(수출), sensitive(민감한) ↔ resistant(저항력 있는), productive(생산적인) ↔ unproductive(비생산적인)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great (A)[importance / indifference] to achieving food security. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the (B)[resident / temporary] population. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and (C)[imports / restrictions].
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② importance — resident — imports: 원문 일치
❌ ① temporary: 일시적 인구가 아닌 거주 인구
❌ ③ indifference: 무관심이 아닌 중요성을 부여
❌ ④ restrictions: 제한이 아닌 수입에 의존

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of ①<u>mechanisms</u> have been developed to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that ②<u>adequate</u> amounts of food are available to the resident population. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can ③<u>export</u> food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly ④<u>sensitive</u> to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① mechanisms: 원문 그대로, 적절
✅ ② adequate: 원문 그대로, 적절
❌ ③ export: 원문은 import(수입) → export(수출)로 바뀌어 부적절
✅ ④ sensitive: 원문 그대로, 적절
det.tip: import(수입하다) ↔ export(수출하다). 국내에서 생산 어려운 품목은 '수입'해야 함

questions.passage: Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the ①<u>domestic</u> farming system. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Even countries with extremely ②<u>productive</u> agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other ③<u>tropical</u> products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by ④<u>ignoring</u> both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ ignoring(무시하는)은 원문의 relying on(의존하는)과 반대 → 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① domestic: 원문 그대로, 적절
✅ ② productive: 원문 그대로, 적절
✅ ③ tropical: 원문 그대로, 적절
❌ ④ ignoring: 원문은 relying on(의존하다) → ignoring(무시하다)으로 바뀌어 부적절

questions.passage: The governments of ①<u>virtually</u> every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of ②<u>insuring</u> that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to ③<u>climatic</u>, soil and other conditions that tend to ④<u>remain constant</u> around the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ remain constant(일정하게 유지되다)는 원문의 vary(다양하다)와 반대 → 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① virtually: 원문 그대로, 적절
✅ ② insuring: 원문 그대로, 적절
✅ ③ climatic: 원문 그대로, 적절
❌ ④ remain constant: 원문은 vary(다양하다) → remain constant(일정하다)으로 바뀌어 부적절

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that __________ amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에는 adequate(충분한)가 들어가야 한다. 거주 인구에게 충분한 양의 식량을 보장하는 것이 핵심.
det.analysis:
✅ ② adequate: 충분한 양의 식량 보장이라는 맥락에 부합
❌ ① excessive: 과도한 양은 문맥에 맞지 않음
❌ ③ minimal: 최소한의 양은 식량 안보 목표와 부합하지 않음
❌ ④ tropical: 열대의, 문맥과 무관

questions.passage: The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to __________, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에는 climatic(기후의)가 들어가야 한다. 토양과 함께 농산물에 영향을 미치는 조건.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ climatic: 토양, 기타 조건과 병렬 관계로 기후 조건이 적절
❌ ① security: 안보는 이 문맥의 조건 나열과 맞지 않음
❌ ② imports: 수입품은 조건이 아님
❌ ③ mechanisms: 방법은 조건 나열에 부합하지 않음

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system. However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and __________.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에는 imports(수입)가 들어가야 한다. 국내 생산과 수입 '둘 다'에 의존.
det.analysis:
✅ ① imports: domestic production과 병렬로 수입에 의존한다는 맥락
❌ ② restrictions: 제한은 문맥과 반대
❌ ③ obstacles: 장애물은 해결 방법이 아님
❌ ④ sufficiency: 자급자족은 앞에서 불필요하다고 했음
det.tip: both A and B 구조에서 domestic production과 짝을 이루는 것은 imports

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of <u>mechanisms</u> have been developed to realize this goal.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 mechanisms의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ methods: mechanisms의 동의어
❌ ① obstacles: 장애물
❌ ② restrictions: 제한
❌ ④ products: 제품

questions.passage: Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the <u>domestic</u> farming system.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 domestic의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② local: domestic의 동의어 (국내의, 현지의)
❌ ① foreign: 반의어 (해외의)
❌ ③ tropical: 열대의, 무관
❌ ④ productive: 생산적인, 다른 의미

questions.passage: The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the <u>resident</u> population.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 resident의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ inhabiting: resident의 동의어 (거주하는)
❌ ① temporary: 일시적인, 반의어에 가까움
❌ ② productive: 생산적인, 다른 의미
❌ ③ tropical: 열대의, 무관

questions.passage: Even countries with extremely <u>productive</u> agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 productive의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① unfruitful: productive의 반의어
❌ ② efficient: 효율적인, 유사 의미
❌ ③ fertile: 비옥한, 유사 의미
❌ ④ fruitful: 결실 많은, 동의어

questions.passage: Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to <u>vary</u> around the world.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 vary의 의미와 가장 먼 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ remain unchanged: vary의 반의어
❌ ① differ: 다르다, 동의어
❌ ② fluctuate: 변동하다, 유사 의미
❌ ④ change: 변하다, 동의어
det.tip: vary = differ = change ↔ remain unchanged = stay constant

questions.passage:
(A) The governments of virtually every country attach great <u>importance</u> to achieving food security.

(B) The <u>importance</u> of a historical figure is often measured by their lasting influence.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 (A)와 (B)의 importance의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A)에서는 '중요성'(식량 안보를 달성하는 것에 큰 중요성을 부여), (B)에서는 '영향력'(역사적 인물의 영향력).
det.analysis:
✅ ④ (A) 중요성 — (B) 영향력: 문맥에 부합
❌ ① (A)가 영향력이면 attach importance to와 맞지 않음
❌ ② 둘 다 중요성이면 (B)의 lasting influence 맥락 무시
❌ ③ 둘 다 영향력이면 (A)의 attach ~ to 구문과 안 맞음
det.tip: importance: ① 중요성 ② 영향력, 비중. 문맥에 따라 의미가 달라진다.

questions.stem:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"enough or sufficient for a particular purpose"

det.analysis:
✅ ② adequate: 영영 정의와 일치 (충분한, 적절한)
❌ ① productive: 생산적인
❌ ③ sensitive: 민감한
❌ ④ domestic: 국내의

questions.passage: Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions. Even countries with extremely __________ (produce) agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: produce → productive: 형용사 위치(extremely _____ sectors)이므로 형용사형으로 변환
det.analysis:
정답: productive (원형: produce)
허용: productive, Productive, productive.
det.tip: produce(동사: 생산하다) → productive(형용사: 생산적인) → productivity(명사: 생산성)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country attach great importance to achieving food __________. (secure) A wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.analysis:
정답: security (원형: secure)
허용: security, Security, security.
det.tip: secure(형용사: 안전한) → security(명사: 안보, 보안) → securely(부사: 안전하게)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of __________. However, food security does not require this because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ④ food self-sufficiency: 일부 정부는 식량 자급자족 목표를 설정했다는 맥락
❌ ① food imports: 뒤에서 수입은 자급자족의 대안으로 제시됨
❌ ② agricultural exports: 수출은 문맥에 없음
❌ ③ climatic sensitivity: 기후 민감도는 목표가 아님

questions.passage: However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by __________.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: relying on both domestic production and imports

det.korean: 빈칸에는 relying on both domestic production and imports(국내 생산과 수입 모두에 의존)가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ relying on both domestic production and imports: 원문의 결론과 일치
❌ ① achieving complete self-sufficiency: 글에서 자급자족이 필수가 아니라고 했음
❌ ② restricting all food imports: 수입 제한은 오히려 반대
❌ ④ eliminating agricultural sensitivity: 민감성 제거는 불가능한 내용
det.tip: 글의 핵심 주장: 식량 안보 ≠ 자급자족. 국내 생산 + 수입 병행이 해결책
